fact: Tom Allen learned gun-making and then entered the English army during the Crimean War, where his success in turn-ups in front of Sevastopol convinced him he could be a champion.

parts.fact: Tom Allen ran away from home at seventeen, enlisted in the 8th Hussars and served through the Indian Mutiny under General Havelock.

fact: Tom Allen was still married to his wife in England when he died; they had not lived together for years but had never divorced, and his will did not mention her.

parts.fact: Tom Allen had been a widower for twenty to thirty years when he died.
parts.conflict: more than twenty years (197.c3) vs thirty years (1000.c5)
